articles.title_en: Magritte: This Is Still Not a Pipe review – brilliance and trash from the surrealist
articles.title_ru: Magritte: This Is Still Not a Pipe review – brilliance and trash from the surrealist
articles.preview_en: Gagosian Gallery, London With his clever conundrums, the Belgian loved satirising both psychoanalysis and surrealism – and occasionally painted rubbish to annoy his family.
articles.preview_ru: Gagosian Gallery, London With his clever conundrums, the Belgian loved satirising both psychoanalysis and surrealism – and occasionally painted rubbish to annoy his family.
articles.full_en: Gagosian Gallery, London With his clever conundrums, the Belgian loved satirising both psychoanalysis and surrealism – and occasionally painted rubbish to annoy his family. René Magritte is the most inexplicable of artists. It’s much harder to get a handle on him than such supposedly difficult modern greats as Cézanne or Picasso. After all, cubism is a perfectly rational attempt to capture the complexity of reality. He confronts you with wilful mysteries. This show sets choice examples of his magic against modern art and is full of quirky, unexpected treasures that give your wonder at Magritte little twists in new and perverse directions. A painting of puffy white clouds held me across the gallery and still floats ineffably in my mind.

articles.title_en: South African Police Officer Charged with Grooming and Rape
articles.title_ru: Полицейский из Южной Африки обвинён в сексуальном насилии
articles.preview_en: South African police officer Shadrack Sibiya has been charged with grooming a 16‑year‑old and raping an 18‑year‑old.
articles.preview_ru: Полицейский Шадрак Сибия из Южной Африки обвиняется в сексуальном насилии над 16летней и 18летней девушкой.
articles.full_en: The South African Police Service announced that officer Shadrack Sibiya faces multiple sexual offence charges. The charges allege that Sibiya groomed a sixteen‑year‑old girl before raping an eighteen‑year‑old victim. The case emerges amid growing public scrutiny of law enforcement integrity across the continent. The incident highlights systemic challenges within South Africa’s policing institutions and their handling of sexual violence. International observers note that the prosecution could influence global discussions on police accountability and gender‑based crime. Human rights groups urge the authorities to implement transparent investigations and victim support mechanisms. The outcome of Sibiya’s trial may set a precedent for future disciplinary actions against senior officers.
articles.full_ru: Южноафриканская полиция объявила, что офицер Шадрак Сибия обвиняется в нескольких сексуальных преступлениях. Обвинения утверждают, что Сибия воспитал 16летнюю девушку, а затем изнасиловал 18летнюю жертву. Это дело появляется на фоне усиливающегося общественного контроля над правопорядком в Африке. Инцидент подчёркивает системные проблемы в структуре полиции Южной Африки и её подходе к сексуальному насилию. Международные наблюдатели считают, что судебный процесс может повлиять на глобальные дискуссии о подотчётности полицейских. Правозащитные организации призывают к прозрачному расследованию и поддержке пострадавших. Решение по делу Сибии может стать прецедентом для будущих дисциплинарных мер против высших офицеров.
